All operations are confined to the package build directory and final package directory, with no access to or manipulation of system-wide resources outside of standard packaging procedures.

There are no signs of malicious behavior such as network exfiltration, dynamic code evaluation, or execution of unverified content. The use of prebuilt binaries is noted, but this is declared in the package description and does not constitute a supply-chain attack in itself. The package follows common AUR packaging practices and poses no evident security risk.
